description: Source code implementing block source abstractions for buffer and file, including functions for reading, releasing, closing, and obtaining size of block data, as well as creating block sources from buffers and files.

classes.name: struct reftable_block_source
classes.description: Represents a block source with function pointers for operations and an argument.

classes.name: struct reftable_block_data
classes.description: Holds data and length of a block.

classes.name: struct reftable_buf
classes.description: Buffer structure used for reftable buffer operations.

classes.name: struct reftable_block_source_vtable
classes.description: Virtual table of function pointers for block source operations.

classes.name: struct file_block_source
classes.description: Represents a file-based block source with size and data pointer.

methods.name: block_source_release_data
methods.description: Releases data associated with a block source.

methods.name: block_source_read_data
methods.description: Reads data from a block source at a given offset.

methods.name: block_source_size
methods.description: Returns the size of a block source.

methods.name: reftable_buf_release_data
methods.description: Releases buffer data, zeroing out memory before freeing.

methods.name: reftable_buf_read_data
methods.description: Reads data from a buffer into a block data structure.

methods.name: reftable_buf_size
methods.description: Returns the size of a buffer.

methods.name: block_source_from_buf
methods.description: Initializes a block source from a buffer.

methods.name: reftable_block_source_from_file
methods.description: Creates a block source from a file given its filename.
